_notes: Hand-curated official targets for the benchmark layer (viz-revamp-roadmap Stage 1). Every non-computed entry cites its official publication and its value was verified against that document at authoring time. No scraper produces or updates this file; it changes rarely (staleness window 400 days). Entries with null values or a TODO/placeholder _source_url are intentional sentinels that the loader (getBenchmarkTargets) provably skips so they can never reach a chart. Since 2026-09-15 each national RPJMN TPT band also carries period_start/period_end: the Makro/SDG TPT charts draw every band clipped to its own administration window (2004-2009, 2010-2014, 2015-2019, 2020-2024, 2025-2029). Verification recipe for rebuilding this file: see docs/RPJMN_TPT_TARGETS.md.

targets.label: Target RPJMN 2004-2009
targets.source_name: Perpres 7/2005 - RPJMN 2004-2009 (Sasaran pertama, Agenda Meningkatkan Kesejahteraan Masyarakat)
targets.verified_note: Full text read 2026-09-15 from a complete copy of Perpres 7/2005: 'terciptanya lapangan kerja yang mampu mengurangi pengangguran terbuka menjadi 5,1 persen pada tahun 2009'. Single-point target (not a band) -> value_min == value_max, renders as a dashed hairline band. Primary doc: Peraturan Presiden No. 7 Tahun 2005 (LN 2005).

targets.label: Target RPJMN 2010-2014
targets.verified_note: Full text of the Perpres (285 pp.) read 2026-09-15 from the JDIH Kota Tanjungpinang copy: 'Dengan pertumbuhan ini, tingkat kemiskinan akan dapat diturunkan menjadi 8%-10% dan tingkat pengangguran terbuka menjadi 5%-6%' (narasi sasaran akhir periode, 2014).

targets.label: Target RPJMN 2015-2019
targets.verified_note: Renstra Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan (official ppid.kemnaker.go.id PDF, full text read 2026-09-15) restating the RPJMN 2015-2019 sasaran pokok: 'Tingkat pengangguran Terbuka sekitar 4% sampai dengan 5% hingga 2019'. Corroborated by the Bappenas Ringkasan RPJMN 2015-2019 Sasaran Makro table (TPT 2019: 4,0-5,0) and the RPJMN 2020-2024 executive summary's 2015-2019 review. Primary doc: Perpres No. 2 Tahun 2015, Lampiran (80 MB fulltext at jdih.kemenkeu.go.id; body text checked too).

targets.label: Target RPJMN 2020-2024
targets.verified_note: Ringkasan Eksekutif RPJMN 2020-2024 (official provincial-hosted copy of the Bappenas narasi; PDF parsed page-by-page 2026-09-15): 'Pada tahun 2024, tingkat kemiskinan dan tingkat pengangguran terbuka diharapkan menurun masing-masing menjadi 6,0 - 7,0 persen dan 3,6 - 4,3 persen'. Primary doc: Perpres No. 18 Tahun 2020, Lampiran I (Narasi RPJM Nasional).

targets.label: Target RPJMN 2025-2029
targets.verified_note: Ringkasan RPJMN Tahun 2025-2029, tabel Sasaran Pembangunan, baris 22 'Tingkat Pengangguran Terbuka (%)': Baseline 2024 = 4,91; Target 2025 = 4,50-5,00; Target 2029 = 4,00-4,71. period_start/period_end added 2026-09-15 so the band draws only over its own administration window.
